primary_objective: stable completed stopping with less jitter
success_first: stopped and held within the forward-distance tolerance
per-wheel native contact and geometry; hockey bilateral criterion preserved
no fall and no non-wheel support
report longitudinal overshoot and lateral excursion

distance_and_lateral_tolerances.rationale: Prospective engineering tolerances; not tuned to new policy outcomes or claimed as real-world calibration.

stability_metrics: 10-100 Hz world angular XY RMS at native 400 Hz
per-wheel contact interruptions and vertical body motion

reward_design.direct: Remove positive lateral-sliding/friction-boundary incentives and hockey-specific success gates; keep common stopping/contact/smoothness terms.
reward_design.comparison_kind: behavior-recipe comparison; not an isolated causal test of the human posture prior

braking_torque: Actuated wheel policy output, not zeroing wheel joint state or prescribing a discontinuous lock
equality_verification: same DR distribution and training transitions
same measured initial speed and raw material audit
contact_criterion: both wheels at every physical sample, native geometry tolerance 0.1 mm, unknown cannot pass
